# The planning community

The KwaZulu-Natal Systematic Conservation Plan has a legacy of robust science backed, built through community involvement. The Ezemvelo KZN Wildlife Conservation Plan Steering Committee, established to guide the plan, works with internal and external scientists to maintain and revise the Conservation Plan. Input from partners, to ensure the plan is aligned to provincial and national objectives is critical.
